name: Bloodmage Blood Burst on the action bar is saved as Hemostasis (#5469)
contract: AscensionBloodmageHemostasis.cpp:48-53 (aura_ascension_hemostasis::Apply): when the Bloodmage's Hemostasis 681304 stun lands on an enemy, the caster gains the re-activation window 302895, learns Blood Burst 803326 with learnSpell(803326, true) (PLAYERSPELL_TEMPORARY, never written to character_spell) and calls SetTemporarySpellReplacement(681304, 803326). The window's removal (line 84) clears it. A button holding Blood Burst 803326 was saved by Player::_SaveActions as 803326; Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before any Hemostasis learns it again, so IsActionButtonDataValid would refuse and delete it. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes: the Blood Burst button must be saved as Hemostasis 681304, and a button holding Hemostasis itself must be saved unchanged. Hemostasis (Spell.dbc) costs 25% health, has no cast time and its window lasts 4000 ms, so every assertion runs inside the window. The target is a Young Wolf (299); the mechanical Harvest Golem (36) did not take the stun and horror, so no window opened.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Hemostasis is replaced by Blood Burst
The Blood Burst button is saved as Hemostasis
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
